newsitem.title: CHINA: China 1997 grain output seen around 1996 level.
newsitem.headline: China 1997 grain output seen around 1996 level.

text.p: China will strive to keep 1997 grain production around the same level as 1996's record harvest of 490 million tonnes, Vice Premier Li Lanqing said on Thursday.
"We must continue to strengthen the position of agriculture, develop the rural economy and work hard to make total grain production reach the level of last year," Li said.
"This spring, agriculture production was looking up," he said. "We are very optimistic about a summer bumper harvest."
China's grain classification includes rice, wheat, corn, soybeans and potatoes.
The bulk of China's wheat, which accounts for around 20 percent of total grain output, is harvested in the summer.
Li was addressing a meeting of the International Chamber of Commerce.
